name: Meeting Notes Classifier And Updating System

parameters.text:
=Analyze the following meeting notes and extract all actionable tasks.

Meeting Notes:
{{ $json["Meeting Notes"] }}

For each task, identify:
- Owner
- Action Item
- Due Date
- Status

Rules:
- Extract only actual assigned tasks.
- If no owner is mentioned, use "Unassigned".
- If no due date is mentioned, use null.
- Set status to "Pending" by default.
- Do not invent information.
- Return valid JSON only.
- Do not add explanations or markdown.

Return exactly in this format:

{
  "tasks": [
    {
      "owner": "Name or Team",
      "action_item": "Task description",
      "due_date": "Deadline",
      "status": "Pending"
    }
  ]
}

parameters.formDescription: Please Enter Your Meeting Notes Below
